in_english.name: Mahsoun
in_english.meaning: Mahsoun refers to a person who is harmless to others, and brings joy to those around him
in_english.long_meaning: Mahsoun is an Arabic name that means 'harmless' or 'without injury', and it is derived from the root word 'sh-a'-n', which means 'to be free from harm' or 'to be without injury'. In Islamic tradition, Mahsoun is considered a praiseworthy name, as it refers to a person who is kind, gentle, and harmless to others. The name Mahsoun is also mentioned in the Quran, in Surah At-Tauba, verse 24, where it refers to the Ahl al-Bayt, or the household of the Prophet Muhammad, who were granted permission to listen and obey, and to participate in the affairs of the Muslims. In modern times, the name Mahsoun has become popular among Muslims, as it is seen as a reflection of the values of kindness, compassion, and harmlessness that are central to the Islamic faith
